senses.gloss: ch. = h. מָרַד I, to rebel, run away.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 15:27">Targ. I Kings XV, 27</cite> (h. text <he>קשר</he>).
Targ. II Kings IX, 14 (ed. Wil. מריד; h. text קשר Hithpa.).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 8:5">Targ. Jer. VIII, 5</cite> <he>למִמְרַד מן</he> ed. Lag. (ed. <he>למרד</he>) to run away from (desert); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 44a:4">Ber. 44ᵃ</cite> <he>עד דמריד</he> until he ran away (bewildered).

senses.gloss: cmp. מֶרֶד II a. רָדָה) to rule.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Lamentations 1:7">Targ. Lam. I, 7</cite>.
<cite ref="Ketubot 63b:9">Keth. 63ᵇ</cite> <he>אִימְּרִידָא</he> Rashi (ed. <he>אִימְרְדָה</he>, Alf. <he>אִימְרְדָא</he>) ran away (from her husband).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 84b:3">B. Mets. 84ᵇ</cite> <he>אימרדה אזלה וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>אימרי׳</he>, v. <cite ref="M02651"><he>מְרִי</he></cite>) she ran away and went to her paternal home.
